I need to create a responsive layout with a collapsible sidebar navigation, a card-based task list with dark mode support, and an accessible modal dialog that pops up when clicking a task to show details. I'm using shadcn/ui components and Tailwind CSS. Can you help me set up the project with the correct dependencies, configure the theme for dark mode using next-themes, and then implement the sidebar (with collapsible sections using the Collapsible component), the task cards (using Card, CardHeader, etc.), and the dialog (using Dialog and DialogTrigger)? Also, I need the layout to be responsive: on mobile, the sidebar should be hidden and a hamburger menu should toggle it. Please provide the code for the components and the required configuration.
